title: Field Service Dispatch Board
idea: Build a field service dispatch board for regional HVAC and electrical operations where dispatchers assign technicians to urgent work orders, track status transitions, and resolve SLA breach alerts.
problemStatement: Build a field service dispatch board for regional HVAC and electrical operations where dispatchers assign technicians to urgent work orders, track status transitions, and resolve SLA breach alerts.

problem_brief.title: Problem Brief — Field Service Dispatch Board

approaches.name: Queue + Technician Capacity Split View
approaches.summary: Filterable priority queue with inline SLA timers paired with a side-by-side technician matcher and status transition panel.
approaches.bestFor: Fast keyboard-and-mouse triage during peak dispatch hours at both desktop and tablet widths.
pros: Shows SLA countdowns, required certifications, and technician workload at a glance
Accessible keyboard navigation and predictable responsive behavior
Clean audit log for every assignment and status change
cons: Does not show multi-hour visual overlap bars like a Gantt chart
risks: Must keep queue filters and selected detail synchronized after status transitions

approaches.name: Full-Screen Drag-and-Drop Gantt Timeline
approaches.summary: Horizontal time-slot grid where dispatchers drag work-order blocks onto technician rows.
approaches.bestFor: Multi-day planned maintenance scheduling on wide monitors.
pros: Visualizes shift gaps across the day
cons: Harder to triage urgent unscheduled emergency calls quickly
risks: Complex drag collision handling when jobs run late

approaches.name: Map-First Geo Pin Board
approaches.summary: Center the dispatch workspace on a full-bleed map canvas with floating overlays for work orders and technicians.
approaches.bestFor: Dense urban courier routing where geographic clustering is the primary decision factor.
pros: Immediate spatial view of technician proximity
cons: Floating drawers obscure map pins when comparing multiple SLA deadlines
Requires external map tile keys and geocoding for every site address
risks: Overlapping pins at multi-unit commercial sites hide urgent alerts
